question: How does the analogy of a busy king show that one’s own luminosity remains unimpaired?
premises: Own luminosity is said to be unimpaired.
A busy king retains his sovereignty.
inference: Just as a busy king’s sovereignty remains intact, one’s own luminosity remains unimpaired.
plain_english: One’s own luminosity remains truly unimpaired, just as the sovereignty of a very busy king remains his own.
